title: Localize InfoDialog's body: resolve the search list and every literal
description: Build a locale-resolved copy of infoSections at the top of the function (needed because the search box filters against actual displayed text, so it must operate on resolved strings, not resource IDs) and replace every remaining hardcoded literal — dialog title, search placeholder, clear-search content description, the no-results template, and the confirm button — with resource-backed lookups.
acceptance_criteria: A local val resolvedSections maps infoSections to ResolvedInfoSection using stringResource(it.titleRes)/stringResource(it.bodyRes)
The search/filter logic (query blank check, .filter { title/body contains query }) now operates on resolvedSections instead of infoSections, with identical matching behavior
The clear-search content description comes from stringResource(R.string.clear_search_content_description)
The no-results text comes from stringResource(R.string.no_topics_match, query)
The forEachIndexed display loop is otherwise unchanged (section.title/section.body remain plain String reads, now sourced from ResolvedInfoSection)
name: InfoDialog
